title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20
source: This is a pitch corrected, patched and re-mastered version of the shnid1234 sbd.hollister source

ai_review.summary: Solid 11/20‑73 performance with a strong cross‑section of period songs, but Sunshine Daydream vocals sound shredded; recording is decent.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the show five stars, calling it an excellent snapshot of the late‑1973 repertoire and noting that it pairs well with Road Trips Vol. 4. The only drawback mentioned is that Bob Weir’s and Donna Jean’s vocal parts on Sunshine Daydream sound shredded, suggesting a minor performance or mic issue. Overall the set is praised as a solid representation of the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review highlights an excellent show with only a minor vocal flaw; recording quality not discussed, so rating leans on show performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity; reviewer notes shredded vocals on Sunshine Daydream, implying a possible mic or vocal issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Provides a solid cross‑section of late‑1973 material; no specific flow comments.

band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal chords sounded shredded on Sunshine Daydream
